label: copy phase: b fed back as original token 1-3, not on the final step
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, only when the input token is b (the model feeding back its own just-emitted b), and almost only when that b was original token 1, 2 or 3 (recall_idx 2-4). It also requires at least one output still to come (to_go >= 1); false positives under the simpler predicate were mostly the final step of short sequences. Magnitude is largest when b is original token 1 (recall_idx 2, about 54% of activation mass; the top examples are all x b ... <DEL> x [b]) and drops off for later positions. The output token makes no difference. Never fires on b in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on any other input token. Weak residual activity appears on b at later recall positions (recall_idx >= 5) and at recall_idx 1 (b as the first token); this accounts for about 0.5% of mass.

issues: The test score reproduces: P 0.948, R 0.961, F1 0.955, mass recall 0.995. Coverage is 1.0 in the top two activation quartiles and 0.85 in the lowest.

Every factual claim checks out on dev. Activation is zero in the original and delimiter phases. 40,835 of the 40,836 active steps have in_tok b; the one exception is a t. recall_idx 2, 3 and 4 hold 54%, 38% and 8% of the activation mass. recall_idx 1 and recall_idx >= 5 together hold about 0.5%.
The to_go >= 1 clause is justified by a clean pattern. The cells it removes (recall_idx 2 with L=3, recall_idx 3 with L=4, recall_idx 4 with L=5) have precision 0.0, 0.0 and 0.05.

Remaining false positives are concentrated in a few cells where the feature fires weakly. recall_idx 4 with L=6 has precision 0.67 (923 dev false positives); this is to_go == 1, but recall_idx 3 with L=5 is also to_go == 1 and has precision 0.997, so to_go alone does not explain it. recall_idx 2 with L=4 has precision 0.85, and recall_idx 4 with L=9 has 0.86. Every other cell is about 1.0.

No context variable separates the weak cells. Within recall_idx 4, L=6, precision stays in the 0.55-0.78 range across: whether b is repeated in the sequence (in_count), whether the output or next output is a digit, digit count, and whether the output is a vowel.
Excluding the weak recall_idx 4, L=6 cell lowers test F1 to 0.940, so the original predicate is close to optimal.

Minor overclaim: 'the output token makes no difference' is only approximately true. In the weak cell, precision varies from 0.55 when the output is a vowel to 0.73 when it is a digit. This does not change the overall explanation.
